description: This Java class implements a cache for tenant profiles in the Thingsboard transport service, managing profile retrieval, updates, and associations with tenants, including lazy loading and rate limiting.

classes.name: DefaultTransportTenantProfileCache
classes.description: Implements a cache for tenant profiles, handling profile retrieval, updates, and tenant-profile associations with thread safety and rate limiting.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant profile for a given tenant ID, loading from transport service if not cached.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates the cache with a new tenant profile from a proto message.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates a tenant ID with a tenant profile ID, updating cache mappings.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all tenant associations for a given profile ID from the cache.

methods.name: getTenantProfile
methods.description: Internal method to fetch tenant profile, performing lazy load with locking and updating rate limits.
